headline: Bottas says he is 'pretty confident' of staying at Cadillac for 2027
body: Valtteri Bottas has not been confirmed for 2027 although Cadillac has extended Sergio Perez. His 'multi-year' deal is understood to be one-plus-one with an optional second season, and reserve driver Colton Herta is linked to a promotion once he has his super licence. Bottas says he expects decisions from Cadillac's board soon.
